fixture.model: ScriptedLLM, a subclass of openhands.sdk.testing.TestLLM; LLM.completion/acompletion of every LLM instance are routed to it (the agent server re-validates the agent on start and loads it from base_state.json on resume, which yields a plain LLM). No provider is called.

index_rules.count: protocol fixture: model calls in this process + agent replies recorded in the persisted log (full log)
index_rules.visible: reply chosen from the tool results the model is shown (what a competent real model would do)

fixture.tools: lookup, charge (ToolDefinition + ToolExecutor); ledger.jsonl outside the store, fsync before return
fixture.idempotency_key: not forwarded: ToolExecutor.__call__(action, conversation) receives no tool_call_id or key
fixture.kill_points: os.kill(getpid(), SIGKILL) inside the tool (W1, W2, W2c), inside the scripted model (W3), inside ConversationState.set_write_guard's guard around EventLog.append (W4a before, W4b after the charge observation file write), after run() returns WAITING_FOR_CONFIRMATION on charge (W6)

paths.sdk: LocalConversation(persistence_dir, conversation_id); resume = construct again + run()
paths.server: openhands.agent_server.event_service.EventService in-process (start() = lease claim + stale-RUNNING recovery; run(); wait_for_run_completion()), no HTTP

e1.invalid_args_handled: Scripted charge without `amount`: pydantic validation of ChargeAction failed in Agent._get_action_event, an AgentErrorEvent ('Error validating tool charge: ... amount Field required') went back to the model, the tool never ran; the next scripted reply was valid. 4 model calls, ledger 1 lookup + 1 charge.
e1.retries: 1 (model-driven, after the validation error; no runtime retry)

e2.store: LocalFileStore: one JSON file per event (atomic_write_text: temp file, fsync, os.replace; no directory fsync) + base_state.json (same writer); EventLog append under a file lock
e2.resume_api: sdk: Conversation(agent, workspace, persistence_dir, conversation_id).run(); server: EventService(stored, conversations_dir, agent=None).start() then run()

W1-sdk-count.notes: Kill at charge entry (ActionEvent fsynced, no ledger line). HEAD (leaf_event_id in base_state.json) is saved only when the step's `with state:` block exits, so the charge ActionEvent is off the active branch on reload. The bare SDK sees no pending action; the model is asked again. count rule: it answers final with no charge (a false completion); visible rule: it re-decides charge (1 charge). The original ActionEvent stays unmatched in the full log forever.

After restart the action looks un-approved; approving again (run()) re-executes it via implicit confirmation: duplicate_effect with no model involvement.

W6-sdk-count.notes: AlwaysConfirm; SIGKILL while WAITING_FOR_CONFIRMATION on charge. The step ended, so HEAD covers the pending ActionEvent and the status persisted. Approval after restart = run(), which executes the pending action (implicit confirmation): 1 charge. Caveat: on cold load the view's ToolCallMatchingProperty drops the unmatched ActionEvent from the LLM view, so the next model call is shown a charge tool result whose tool call is missing (visible_assistant=1 with 2 tool results).
